ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (Revised 2024); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Market Entities (PBOC and SAMR Joint Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Amendment) and its Implementing Regulation; Regulation on the Registration of Market Entities (State Council Order No. 746); Administrative Measures on Enterprise Name Registration (State Administration for Market Regulation, 2021).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Foreign Parent Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of Companies in the foreign investor's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a competent national notary followed by either (A) an Apostille issued by the competent Apostille authority of the issuing country if that country is a Hague Apostille Convention member state, or (B) legalization by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate having consular jurisdiction if the issuing country is not an Apostille Convention member state. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive; neither is sequential with the other.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Existence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or Companies House equivalent in the jurisdiction of the foreign parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Apostille for Apostille Convention states; for non-member states, notarization plus consular legalization by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate. Do not apply both processes; select solely according to the signing state's convention membership.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Irrevocable Power of Attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the foreign parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The board resolution and the power of attorney must be signed in front of a notary public in the issuing jurisdiction, then authenticated by Apostille (Hague Convention state) or by consular legalization (non-Hague state). Apostille and consular legalization are substitutes, never complements.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association or Memorandum and Articles of Association
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign parent company secretary and notarial public office in the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization of the constitutional document followed by apostille if the country of issuance acceded to the Hague Convention, and only by consular legalization if it did not. Each instrument must carry either an apostille or consular legality certification, not both.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from the Foreign Parent's Principal Bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The commercial bank where the foreign parent maintains a current account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank must countersign the letter before a notary; after notarization, the document is either apostilled by the bank's national Apostille Authority (if the bank's state is a Convention party) or legalized by the Chinese consulate (if not). These two authentication modes are mutually exclusive; no combination, no chaining.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: It is mandatory to screen all natural persons holding 10% or more equity, vital administrative personnel, and every representative appointed to the WFOE against the following lists: OFAC Special Designated Nationals (SDN) and Sectoral Sanctions Identifications (SSI), United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, US Specially Designated Global Terrorist (SDGT), UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, and the Public Security Department list of the People's Bank of China. For each match, enhanced due diligence (EDD) is required, including source of funds verification. PEPs from FATF-recognized jurisdictions must be identified and subject to continuous transaction monitoring. Adverse media screening must be refreshed every 30 days. The compliance officer must document negative findings and escalation procedures before incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Enterprise Name Independent Declaration Platform of the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) national online service portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE registered Chinese name must follow a four-tier construction: administrative division; a unique trade name; a business characteristic designating the grain-silo/elevator construction industry; and the legal form "Limited Liability Company". The characters must be simplified Chinese characters in accordance with the national standard table; the foreign parent may adopt a phonetic transliteration of its trade name that is not confusingly similar to an existing registered name. Latin-script transliterations are not registered and have no legal force; the Chinese name is the only legal name for the WFOE.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must obtain the written rejection notice containing the statutory basis and reasons. An administrative reconsideration application must be filed within 60 days of receipt to the next-higher market regulation authority, attaching the rejection notice, the original name application documents, and certified Chinese translations. If the higher authority sustains the rejection, an administrative lawsuit may be brought in the People's Court within six months of notice. Where such documents are executed abroad, they must be notarized and apostilled or consularized as applicable. The compliance officer must calendar all deadlines and obtain a stamped receipt for every filing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible for this construction-industry WFOE because the tax authorities and banks require a verifiable physical location for invoice registration, VAT administration, and basic deposit account opening. At least one leased suite in a municipal commercial building must be presented as the registered office, evidenced by a lease contract filed with SAMR and the local tax bureau. A registration-only address is treated as a red flag and will block bank account opening and increase audit risk.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Unannounced on-site inspection risk is estimated at 20% per year during the first two years of operation. Triggers: VAT invoice anomalies, mismatch between the registered address and actual business premises, fewer than one registered employee per 5 million USD of contract value, complaints, and random annual anti-fraud audits. This probability rises to 50% if the company has the same registered address as 5 or more other market entities.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company registry statutory registration and business license issuance fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff – zero official fee for enterprise registration in mainland China

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Estimated blended fee covering notarization per instrument, apostille fees (10-50 USD each) or consular legalization fees (50-150 USD each), plus courier and logistics

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank account opening and KYC support for the WFOE
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial bank (PRC) and supporting law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank account setup fee typically zero for basic RMB account; legal support billed at 2-3 hours x 200-300 USD per hour

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective July 1, 2024), Articles 24 to 47, 50, 59, 68, 93 and 102; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2020), Articles 2, 4, 28 and 31; Regulations for the Implementation of the Law on Foreign Investment; and applicable registration rules of the State Administration for Market Regulation for foreign-invested enterprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Market Supervision Administration at the district/city level where the WFOE registered office is located in mainland China.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Establishment Registration Application submitted through the local Market Supervision Administration integrated online one-window foreign investment registration portal, together with the notarized and signed Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No general statutory minimum paid-up capital for a WFOE under the PRC Company Law; capital is subscribed in the Articles of Association and must be fully paid within the contribution period stated therein, not exceeding five years for a limited liability company under the 2023 revision. Foreign investors must remit paid-in capital through a domestic capital account and complete State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) foreign exchange registration. There is no blocked escrow account requirement at the national level; however, if the WFOE applies for construction enterprise qualification, MOHURD rules may require specified registered capital and paid-in capital thresholds evidenced by a capital verification report.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Board of Directors hereby fixes and adopts the subscribed registered capital of the Company as [amount in RMB], allocated among the shareholders in accordance with the executed Subscription Schedule, and each director confirms that the capital contribution obligations are lawful, enforceable and payable to the Company's capital contribution account in cash or in-kind asset permitted by the PRC Company Law; and the Company shall accept the capital subscriptions and issue capital contribution certificates. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Chairman, the General Manager and the Chief Financial Officer be and hereby are severally authorized to open one or more Basic Deposit Accounts, foreign currency capital accounts and general deposit accounts in the PRC and overseas in the name of the Company, to execute bank mandates, to register online banking administrators, and to approve wire transfers, noting that all bank instruments shall require two valid signatures from the Authorized Signatories, subject to the Company's financial seal policy. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be and hereby is fixed at [address], being the address shown in the Registered Office Lease; the Legal Representative and the General Manager are directed to file the registered address with the Market Supervision Administration and to accept all statutory notices at that registered office. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following persons be and hereby are appointed to the statutory offices of the Company: [Name] as Chairman of the Board and Legal Representative, [Name] as General Manager, [Name] as Chief Financial Officer, and [Name] as Supervisor. Each appointee shall be vested with the powers and subject to the duties provided by law, and the Legal Representative is directed to sign all registration forms. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Board adopts the incumbency structure and authorizes the Legal Representative to execute all documents necessary for corporate registration, tax registration, foreign exchange registration, construction enterprise qualification licensing, environmental assessment filings and bank account opening. All prior acts of the subscribers and the initial legal representative in connection with incorporation are ratified. This resolution shall take effect immediately and shall continue until amended by a subsequent board resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation, Business Scope Confirmation and Foreign Investment Pre-Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), local Market Supervision Administration, and the province-level Government Service Net online portal for foreign-invested enterprise pre-registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign investor or its authorized formation agent shall log into the local Market Supervision Administration's integrated online service platform, select the foreign-invested company registration channel, and pre-file the proposed WFOE name in the structural form administrative district plus trade name plus industry characteristics plus Limited Liability Company. The filing shall also include registered capital, shareholder identification, registered office address and a precise business scope covering slip-form reinforced concrete silo construction, grain elevator and aeration tower installation, and agricultural silo EPC ancillary works. The system automatically checks name duplication and negative-list compatibility. If the negative-list screening identifies a restricted sector, the applicant must either remove the restricted item or obtain the required foreign investment access approval from the competent authority before proceeding.
required_dossiers: Notarized and apostilled or legalized certificate of incorporation of the foreign investor
Power of attorney appointing the formation agent or local representative
Identity certificates of the prospective legal representative and all proposed directors
Proposed English and Chinese business scope for slip-form concrete silo construction and aeration tower works
Registered office lease agreement or property ownership certificate for the intended address
Foreign investor financial standing letter or bank reference
Foreign Investment Negative List compliance self-assessment form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is suspended, propose three alternative names and refile through the same portal. If a proposed business scope item is considered restricted by the Foreign Investment Negative List, narrow the WFOE scope, restructure as a joint venture with a Chinese party, or file the appropriate access approval request before re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: WFOE Establishment Registration and Issuance of Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration at the district/city level where the registered office is located; online through the integrated whole-process foreign investment registration portal operated by SAMR.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After name pre-approval, the foreign investor shall submit the Foreign-Invested Enterprise Establishment Registration Application, the signed Articles of Association, the initial shareholders resolution, the first board resolution, the supervisor appointment, the legal representative identity certificate and proof of the registered address. The application must state accurately the subscribed capital schedule, contribution method, term of operation and corporate governance provisions. The Market Supervision Administration will verify shareholder eligibility, article compliance, and address availability. Upon approval, SAMR will issue the business license with a Unified Social Credit Code and online corporate registry record. The WFOE is not required at this stage to prove paid-in capital or place funds in escrow, but the contribution schedule must be achievable within the legal maximum period.
required_dossiers: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Establishment Registration Application form
Notarized Articles of Association signed by all shareholders
Board resolution appointing legal representative and officers
Supervisor appointment letter
Legal representative and supervisor identity certificates
Registered office certificate and lease agreement
Foreign investor certificate of incorporation or equivalent eligibility document
Power of attorney for the authorized filer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a rectification notice, respond with corrected Articles or supplemental documents within ten working days. If final rejection is entered, the applicant may apply for administrative reconsideration within sixty days, commence an administrative lawsuit within six months, or file a fresh application after curing all defective items.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Seal Engraving, Bank Account Opening, Tax Registration and Foreign Exchange Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau licensed seal engraving unit, licensed commercial bank in China, State Taxation Administration local tax service hall or e-tax portal, and State Administration of Foreign Exchange (acting through the opening bank).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The WFOE shall first engrave the company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal and contract seal at a Public Security Bureau licensed engraving unit and file the seal impressions with public security records. The legal representative must then attend the bank in person with the business license, board resolution authorizing account opening, company seals and identity documents, and open the Basic Deposit Account, a foreign currency capital account and any necessary general deposit accounts. The bank will conduct beneficial ownership verification and anti-money laundering due diligence. The company must complete tax registration and tax reporting settings within thirty days after the business license date, obtain the tax controls for e-invoicing, and complete SAFE foreign exchange registration through the bank. Every subsequent foreign currency capital injection must be reported in the SAFE capital project system before conversion and use.
required_dossiers: Business License with Unified Social Credit Code
Board resolution specifically authorizing bank account opening
Company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal and contract seal
Legal representative and financial officer identity documents
Beneficial ownership declaration and corporate structure chart
Foreign investor certificate of incorporation
Registered office lease agreement
Articles of Association and board incumbency list
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank identifies discrepancies in beneficial ownership or source of funds, provide a notarized source-of-funds statement, updated corporate registry records and banking reference. If SAFE suspension occurs, rectify the reported capital schedule and resubmit through the bank within five working days or obtain a SAFE waiver letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Construction Enterprise Qualification and Safety Production License Sizing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Housing and Urban-Rural Development Department under MOHURD, and the provincial emergency management bureau or local emergency management department for the safety production license.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The WFOE must apply for the appropriate construction enterprise qualification series, usually the general construction contracting qualification for building construction works or the specialized qualification for slip-form and reinforced concrete concrete works, depending on the value and scope of intended silo contracts. The application must demonstrate registered capital, technical personnel such as registered construction engineers and safety officers, company quality records, construction machinery lists and a written safety management system. After MOHURD issues the Foreign-Invested Construction Enterprise Qualification Certificate, the WFOE must separately apply for the Construction Enterprise Safety Production License, submitting a safety production responsibility system, special operation personnel certificates, emergency rescue measures, site safety insurance and training records. The safety production license is mandatory before executing any silo construction contract, and the WFOE may not qualify by relying on another entity's qualification.
required_dossiers: Foreign-Invested Construction Enterprise Qualification application form
Business License and Unified Social Credit Code certificate
Registered capital and paid-in capital verification report if required by local MOHURD rules
Employment contracts and qualification certificates of registered construction engineers and safety officers
Safety production management system and emergency rescue plan
List of construction machinery, slip-form equipment and vertical lifting equipment
Quality management, occupational health and environmental management certifications
Past project performance records if qualification upgrade is sought
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for technical staffing deficiencies, supplement missing certificates or recruit qualified personnel and await database verification. If the safety production license is refused, corrective safety training, system revision and re-application may be made after thirty days; unlawful denial may be appealed to MOHURD or the administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Impact Assessment Filing or Approval, Fire Protection Design Review and Completion Safety Acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment, local housing and urban-rural development department, local Fire Rescue Section under the Ministry of Emergency Management, and the construction quality supervision station.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before construction commences, the WFOE shall submit the environmental impact assessment registration form or full environmental impact report for the slip-form silo project and obtain the official filing receipt or approval letter. The site must implement the environmental three-simultaneous obligations, including grain dust suppression, temporary domestic wastewater treatment, noise barriers and construction waste sorting. For the silo and aeration tower, the WFOE shall engage a qualified design institute to prepare special fire protection design documents and structural calculations, submit them for fire protection design review, and obtain the fire rescue authority approval where the silo height or floor area exceeds the statutory threshold. During construction, the construction quality supervision station must be notified for key inspections of slip-form platforms, concrete strength, verticality and reinforcing steel. Before operation, the WFOE must complete fire protection completion acceptance, occupational safety facility completion acceptance, and any civil defense or air defense clearance triggered by the project footprint.
required_dossiers: EIA registration form or EIA report with official acceptance receipt or approval letter
Construction project planning and architectural drawings
Structural design certificate and seismic design review opinion
Special fire protection design review application and fire protection drawings
Special construction schemes for slip-form platforms, silo climbing forms and aeration tower erection
Work safety facility design and completion acceptance documents
Civil defense and air defense facility requirement determination
Construction site emergency response drill records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the EIA is escalated to a higher category, commission an EIA-certified institution to prepare a full report and conduct required public participation. If fire protection design review is rejected, revise the design and resubmit within ten working days. If site safety inspection identifies life safety violations, stop work immediately, implement the enforcement directive and obtain re-inspection clearance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (MOHURD), provincial housing and urban-rural development departments, Ministry of Emergency Management (MEM), and local Fire Rescue Sections with construction quality supervision.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign-Invested Construction Enterprise Qualification Certificate for slip-form reinforced concrete works and general building construction, together with the Construction Enterprise Safety Production License; additional permits include vertical lifting machinery installation filing, special equipment registration for construction elevators and hoists, and temporary construction site fire safety registration.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) and the provincial Department of Ecology and Environment for the site of the grain silo project.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: The project baseline category is an Environmental Impact Registration Form for a bare slip-form concrete silo and aeration tower construction site. If the project includes supporting grain drying, fumigation chambers, chemical warehouses, wastewater treatment plants or substantial dust-generating grain transfer systems, the category is elevated to an Environmental Impact Report Form requiring formal approval before construction. Final classification must be confirmed under the current MEE EIA Classification Management List and the local ecological environment bureau.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Quantitative and operational thresholds: air emissions from silo filling points, elevator heads and conveyor transfer points must be captured with baghouse or cartridge dust collectors, with stack particulate matter not exceeding 120 mg/m3 and fugitive boundary total suspended particulates not exceeding 1.0 mg/m3 under GB 16297-1996; grain dryers, if installed, must comply with local particulate and odor limits under GB 14554-93. Wastewater from construction camps and domestic sources must be pretreated and may only be discharged into municipal sewers if compliant with GB/T 31962-2015 or GB 8978-1996 Grade III, with zero direct discharge into natural water bodies. Hazardous waste, including waste hydraulic oil, lubricants, spent filters and chemical containers, must be classified under the National Hazardous Waste Inventory, stored in compatible sealed containers on impermeable secondary containment, labeled and manifested electronically, and transported to licensed disposal facilities within one year.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil defense and fire clearance require special fire protection design review and fire completion acceptance for the silo and aeration tower, with fire separation distances, egress, hydrant flow and smoke ventilation per GB 50016-2014 (2018 edition) and GB 50974-2014. Structural load inspection requires third-party verification of slip-form concrete wall thickness, verticality, silo hopper loads, seismic zone compliance and storage load provisions per GB 50011-2010, GB 50077-2017 and GB 50113-2005 before slip-form operations. Occupational clearance requires the work safety facility three-simultaneous design, construction and completion acceptance under the Law on Work Safety, special construction scheme review for slip-form platforms, confined-space entry in silos, aerial lift operations and emergency rescue planning, together with site fire prevention arrangements per GB 50720-2011.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; territorial administration is exercised by the provincial or municipal tax service bureau where the WFOE is legally registered; online electronic portal is the Electronic Tax Bureau (eTax), accessible through the STA official website (www.chinatax.gov.cn) and provincial electronic tax service systems.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and obtain the Business License bearing the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which constitutes the sole statutory taxpayer identification number (TIN) for Chinese tax purposes. Step 2: Within 30 calendar days after the Business License is issued, complete tax registration with the competent local STA tax service bureau through the Electronic Tax Bureau (eTax) using the USCC and the legal representative's real-name authenticated eTax account; the SAMR data is automatically transmitted to the STA, but the taxpayer must supplement its taxpayer profile. Step 3: In the tax registration, file the registered address, legal representative, business scope, banking account information, accounting system, financial records location, and expected VAT taxpayer classification. Step 4: Once the STA validates the submitted information, the taxpayer registration is activated; the USCC remains the TIN, and the STA system confirmation functions as the registration proof. Step 5: If projected annual taxable sales from construction services exceed RMB 5,000,000, apply for general VAT taxpayer registration; otherwise the WFOE may remain a small-scale taxpayer or voluntarily elect general VAT taxpayer status if it satisfies accounting and internal control requirements. Step 6: Begin statutory filing obligations, including VAT, Enterprise Income Tax, urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, stamp duty, and any applicable property and land taxes, through the Electronic Tax Bureau.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The PRC tax system has no check-the-box or disregarded-entity election for WFOEs; the entity is always a resident enterprise subject to Enterprise Income Tax at 25% on worldwide income. No hybrid mismatch election is available under Chinese domestic tax law. The only relevant election is the VAT taxpayer-status election: a small-scale taxpayer may voluntarily apply for general VAT taxpayer registration if it meets the accounting and control requirements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the Provisional Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Value-Added Tax, the Implementing Rules, and applicable Ministry of Finance and STA circulars; import VAT is collected by customs at the border.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold for basic taxpayer registration; every WFOE must obtain tax registration upon incorporation. The VAT general-taxpayer mandatory registration threshold is annual taxable sales exceeding RMB 5,000,000. Below that, small-scale taxpayer levy rates apply, while a general taxpayer is subject to the statutory VAT rates: 13% for goods, 9% for construction services, and 6% for many services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The PRC has a mandatory electronic invoicing system administered by the STA. VAT special invoices and ordinary invoices must be issued through the STA Golden Tax system or the Electronic Invoice Service Platform, using the taxpayer's digital U-Key or the fully digitalized electronic invoice mechanism. Fully digitalized e-invoices are generated in real time, carry a unique electronic invoice number and STA digital signature/tax-control code, and are automatically verified by the tax authority without a physical clearance stamp. Input VAT must be confirmed by the taxpayer through the VAT Invoice Comprehensive Service Platform before crediting the VAT special invoice. High-volume taxpayers may connect via system-to-system API to upload invoice data; all invoice issuance is subject to real-time invoice quota monitoring and anti-fraud digital authentication.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For goods exported from China: (1) the exporter must be a VAT general taxpayer; (2) the goods must actually be exported and leave China Customs territory; (3) the sale must be made to a non-resident buyer under an export contract; (4) the export goods must be declared to customs using an Export Goods Customs Declaration Form; (5) export proceeds must be received and repatriated in accordance with State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) rules; and (6) the VAT zero-rating must be supported by the export tax refund (exemption) declaration and relevant documentation. Construction services physically performed in China on domestic immovable property are not zero-rated and are subject to 9% VAT. Qualifying offshore services or digital services supplied cross-border may be treated as VAT-exempt or zero-rated only if they fall within the STA's published cross-border taxable services catalogue, are supplied to a non-resident, are consumed entirely outside China, and are supported by contracts, delivery evidence, and payment repatriation records.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Goods Customs Declaration Form / export Bill of Entry issued by the General Administration of Customs of the PRC, including the customs release/clearance record)
Bill of Lading (B/L) or equivalent international transport document evidencing physical outbound shipment
Inward Remittance Certificate / Export Proceeds Settlement Certificate (FIRC or the exporting bank's export collection and settlement confirmation issued under SAFE regulations)
Commercial invoice, packing list, and export sales contract/purchase order
VAT special invoices for purchased goods and services reflected in the exported goods (for input VAT rebate computation)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA and the General Administration of Customs may deny or claw back VAT zero-rating or refunds if the export is unlawful, the goods do not actually leave China, the declared value is materially inaccurate, export proceeds are not repatriated within the prescribed deadline, or documentation is forged or incomplete. Under the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Tax Collection, a fraudulent export tax refund is subject to recovery of the refunded amount and a penalty of one to five times the tax evaded. Tax authorities may retrospectively assess without limitation period in cases of tax evasion, fraud, or intentional non-declaration. Criminal liability may also be pursued under the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China for export tax refund fraud, including imprisonment and confiscation of property. The entity may additionally be downgraded in the STA taxpayer credit rating, lose its export-rebate qualification, and be listed under the joint discipline mechanism for ineligible taxpayers.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBoC) and its State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) as the delegated enforcement authority
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange rate regime in which the RMB is convertible for current account items under the Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations (2008). Capital account transactions remain strictly regulated, with prior approval or registration required for most inbound and outbound investments. For a WFOE, registered capital contributions are classified under capital account and must be injected through a corresponding foreign-exchange capital settlement account after completing SAFE foreign direct investment (FDI) registration. Once in place, the funds may be converted into RMB only after bank verification of the underlying business purpose, using the 'truthfulness and matching' principle. Profit remittance is permitted on a current account basis, allowing a wholly foreign-owned enterprise to convert RMB profits into foreign currency and remit dividends abroad, provided that audited financial statements, a profit distribution resolution, and tax settlement certificates are presented to the designated bank. Surrender requirements are limited: exporters maintain the right to retain or sell current account receipts through designated banks, with no fixed mandatory conversion ratio. However, all trade receipts must be repatriated into domestic accounts within the agreed commercial payment term, generally not exceeding 90 days, and must be adequately documented with customs declarations. The real operational hurdle is not documentary convertibility but the transaction-level compliance burden and the risk classification imposed by the bank's KYC review.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the SAFE trade-in-goods framework, there is no legal mandate for a fixed conversion ratio of export foreign currency receipts to RMB. A WFOE may retain up to 100% of its export proceeds in its current foreign-exchange account or sell them to a designated bank. However, Article 9 of the Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations requires that current account receipts be repatriated to China and not be arbitrarily deposited overseas. The bank will enforce a repatriation-within-due-term rule: for standard open-account export transactions, collection should occur within 90 days of the export customs declaration date; where the underlying contract provides for a longer payment term, prior SAFE approval or registration must be obtained, and the extension cannot exceed 180 days without special exemption. The export proceeds must be credited to the entity's current account with a designated foreign exchange bank immediately upon receipt, and the bank will file the transaction data with SAFE via the trade monitoring system on the same banking day.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Capital Settlement Account for FDI registered capital
Foreign Exchange Capital Settlement Account for FDI registered capital
RMB Basic Deposit Account for daily operations
RMB Basic Deposit Account for daily operations
Foreign Exchange Current Account for export proceeds and trade settlements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Cross-border fintech EMIs (e.g., Revolut Business, Wise Business, Payoneer, Airwallex) are not viable as the sole or primary banking channel for a Chinese WFOE. Under the Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations and the PBoC's licensing framework, only banks authorized by SAFE to conduct foreign exchange business may open corporate accounts for entities registered in China and process capital-account or current-account settlements. Offshore EMIs are typically not licensed to maintain local RMB or FX accounts for Chinese domestic entities, and any attempt to route inbound FDI or trade proceeds through such channels would contravene SAFE rules on direct reporting and documentary authentication. Accordingly, an EMI can be used only in a supporting role for ancillary transactions (e.g., paying overseas vendors below regulatory thresholds) but must never be used for capital injections, foreign exchange settlement, or dividend repatriation. The effective rating is 'not feasible' for primary use; legal recourse for treasury officers is limited to licensed commercial banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a newly formed WFOE, the statutory legal representative, or a fully authorized manager holding a notarized power of attorney, must appear in person at the designated branch of the chosen commercial bank to sign account opening documents, activate online banking, and provide specimen signatures. Remote consular proxy opening alone is generally not accepted for capital-account or basic deposit accounts because PBoC Customer Identification Procedures require a face-to-face interview, document verification, and beneficial ownership attestation. Some branches may accept video-based identity verification as a supplement, but final signature registration and key-card issuance require physical attendance of the legal representative or a local proxy bearing a notarized power of attorney and a valid Chinese visa or residence permit. For foreign legal representatives residing abroad, the practical route is to appoint a resident general manager as the authorized signatory, with the foreign representative attending the initial bank meeting or executing a Chinese notariat-approved power of attorney in favor of the resident manager.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO and ownership chain opacity: circular ownership, offshore shell intermediate, or bearer shares identified in the corporate registry
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a notarized corporate organizational chart tracing every intermediate holding company up to the natural person UBO; certified copies of registration certificates and constitutional documents for each entity in the chain; a signed UBO declaration form; passport or national ID copies of every shareholder holding 10% or more of the WFOE; and a source-of-wealth statement for each ultimate beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of inbound capital injection: cross-border wire in a large lump sum from a jurisdiction perceived to have high trade-based money laundering risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit audited financial statements of the investing parent for the last two fiscal years; six months of original bank statements for the remitting entity; board resolution approving the capital contribution; certified loan agreement if the injection is debt-funded; tax clearance certificates of the parent jurisdiction; and a detailed written narrative explaining the funding chain for the grain silo construction project.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Adverse media, Sanctions, or PEP screening hit on a director or UBO
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a police clearance certificate from the person's country of residence issued within 90 days; a legal opinion from a qualified attorney confirming the person is not a politically exposed person or that the screening hit is a false positive; official employment history and prior companies; and a written explanation of any asset freeze or denial risk identified by the bank's compliance database.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business purpose mismatch: the construction company title does not clearly support large disbursements for imported equipment or subcontractor payments outside the silo project scope
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver the signed EPC (engineering, procurement, and construction) contract with the ultimate client; detailed technical specification sheets for grain silo slip-form equipment and aeration towers; government project registration or NDRC recordation documents; purchase orders from third-party equipment suppliers; proof of physical project site address; and photographic or geolocation evidence of site progress.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The parent company must remit the registered capital in foreign currency via an MT103/SWIFT wire to the WFOE's foreign exchange capital settlement account at a SAFE-designated bank. The wire message must include the full legal name of the beneficiary, the SAFE FDI registration code, and a clear remittance narrative such as 'Capital Contribution under Foreign Direct Investment'. Upon receipt, the bank validates the inflow against the SAFE FDI Registration Certificate and the interbank verification system. Previously the funds are available for conversion into RMB, the WFOE must submit a capital verification report issued by a domestic licensed CPA (or an electronic verification through the Business Registration system), a deposit confirmation, and a detailed schedule of intended expenditure, such as construction materials, equipment, payroll, and lease costs. Conversion into RMB is performed transaction-by-transaction: the bank releases the RMB only after reviewing the relevant underlying contracts, invoices, and tax registrations, consistent with the negative-list approach applied to the enterprise's business scope.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for imported machinery and subcontractor payments are executed through licensed banks using SWIFT MT103 for direct fund transfers and MT700/MT707 for letter-of-credit operations. For cross-border trade in RMB, the payment may alternatively be cleared through the CIPS (Cross-Border Interbank Payment System) while still subject to the same documentary checks. The WFOE must present an import customs declaration, commercial invoice, purchase order or contract, transport document (bill of lading or airway bill), and any required inspection certificate to the remitting bank for authenticity review. Commercial Letters of Credit are strongly preferred for large EPC milestones because they protect against documentary discrepancies and non-performance. Documentary collections are permissible but carry higher risk for the exporter and are generally avoided in silo elevator projects. Domestic disbursements to local subcontractors and material suppliers settle through the CNAPS RMB clearing system using standard bank transfers, supported by contract and fully verified VAT invoices.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts (RMB forward settlement and sale) between RMB and USD, EUR, GBP, or JPY, with a maximum tenor of one year, requiring a real underlying trade or capital exposure and SAFE bank confirmation of the transaction background.

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) overlay is not permitted onshore for the WFOE itself; an offshore parent may hedge its own RMB exposure via offshore NDF markets, but any settlement proceeds must not flow into the WFOE's domestic accounts.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCS) for long-term fixed-asset project loans, subject to SAFE approval and demonstrable unhedged principal exposure; the swap must be pre-filed with the licensed bank and the underlying loan must be remitted into China under the registered capital or current account rails.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Report and Foreign-Invested Enterprise Annual Investment Information Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, shared with the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) and sectoral regulators
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June for the immediately preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inclusion in the Directory of Abnormal Operations within 10 working days after 30 June; failure to rectify for 3 years leads to inclusion in the Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List with cross-department credit restrictions and a 3-year disqualification of the legal representative; if the enterprise fails to operate for six months after establishment without justification, the registration authority may revoke the business license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Reconciliation Filing and Annual CIT Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the competent local tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May of the calendar year following the tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty up to RMB 2,000, or up to RMB 10,000 in serious circumstances, plus a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on unpaid tax; the tax authority may assess tax by estimation, enforce compulsory collection measures, restrict export tax refund privileges, and impose personal liability on the legal representative in aggravated cases.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Direct Investment Equity Registration and Direct Investment Statistics Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through banks or the SAFE online foreign exchange registration system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 June for the previous calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative warning and a fine of up to RMB 50,000 under the foreign exchange administration regulations; the enterprise will be placed on the SAFE anomaly list, and foreign exchange receipts and payments, capital repatriation, and later FDI registration changes may be suspended until the declaration is cured.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Audit of Financial Statements and Shareholder Adoption of Audited Accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not filed with a government agency; the audited financial statements must be submitted to the shareholders, retained at the registered office, and made available to SAMR, STA, MOFCOM and SAFE upon statutory inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audited financial statements must be completed by 31 May following the fiscal year and tabled at the annual shareholders meeting for shareholder adoption
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to procure the statutory audit breaches the PRC Company Law and may render directors liable for damages, prevent lawful corporate income tax reconciliation, and expose the company to inability to complete annual reporting or registration changes until audited financial statements are produced.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: There is no quantitative small-company exemption for a Chinese WFOE: under the PRC Company Law, including the revised Company Law effective 1 July 2024, every company, including a wholly foreign-owned enterprise, must prepare annual financial accounting reports and have them audited by a licensed accounting firm in China regardless of balance sheet size, turnover, or headcount. The de facto statutory threshold is therefore zero. Additional mandatory audits apply where the WFOE is a holding company, prepares consolidated group accounts, or is otherwise designated by a sectoral regulator; qualifying small enterprises may adopt the Accounting Standards for Small Business Enterprises, but that election does not remove the statutory audit obligation for a WFOE.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE/CAS), issued by the Ministry of Finance and substantially converged with IFRS; qualifying small enterprises may alternatively apply the Accounting Standards for Small Business Enterprises; the statutory audit must be performed under PRC auditing standards by a firm registered with the Chinese Institute of Certified Public Accountants, with financial statements expressed in Renminbi, and an additional IFRS consolidation pack may be prepared for the foreign parent reporting group.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Beneficial Owner Information Administration Measures effective 1 November 2024, a WFOE must file beneficial owner information with SAMR at incorporation and within 30 days after any change in shareholding, ultimate ownership, actual control, or management control. A beneficial owner is any person holding or controlling 25% or more of equity or voting rights, or otherwise exercising actual control through other means. Existing enterprises were required to complete the initial beneficial owner filing by 28 February 2025. The annual SAMR Enterprise Information Report and the Foreign-Invested Enterprise Annual Investment Information Report also require confirmation of ultimate investors and actual controllers as at the annual reporting date; shareholding transfers must be updated in the SAMR public registry within 30 days after the transfer and reflected in the on-site register of members.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Legal Representative and Senior Management Personnel
Register of Charges and Pledges over Assets and Equity
Minute Book of Shareholders Meetings, Board Meetings, and Board of Supervisors Meetings

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% preferential rate for High and New Technology Enterprises (HNTE); additional 100% super deduction for qualifying R&D expenses; accelerated depreciation for eligible fixed assets; transitional tax holidays for qualifying encouraged industries in specific western regions; no statutory free-zone income tax holiday applies to standard WFOE in non-special economic zones.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A20000 - Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (A Class), filed through the State Taxation Administration's e-Taxation portal (电子税务局); quarterly provisional filings use Form A20010.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return must be filed within five months after the close of the fiscal year (i.e., by May 31 of the following year); quarterly provisional returns are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total operating income including sales of goods, services, and other business income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross revenue from all sources derived from China and abroad; for a WFOE, allocate revenue based on Chinese accounting standards and adjust for intercompany transactions in accordance with China's transfer pricing rules. Cross-border construction services for grain silo projects must be segmented properly to avoid double taxation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs and allocable overheads related to the realization of revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include material, labor, subcontracting costs, and depreciation on slip-form construction equipment. Substantiate all cross-border service fees and recharges with contemporaneous documentation. Disallowed expenses (e.g., non-compliant invoices) must be added back.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business tax (repealed), VAT surcharges, urban construction tax, education surcharge, and local education surcharge.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only taxes and surcharges economically borne by the enterprise and not creditable against EIT are deductible. VAT is excluded. Import-related duties are not deductible. Ensure that any turnover tax borne by a foreign contractor is separately tracked and supported by a withholding certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 / Line 4 - Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses not directly tied to production, including administrative salaries, rent, and professional fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Entertainment expenses and advertising expenses are subject to statutory deductibility caps. Intercompany management fees from foreign shareholders are not deductible unless supported by a cost-sharing arrangement or service contract satisfying the arm's length standard and beneficial ownership requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit or loss from continuing operations before investment gains and non-operating items.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident contractors deriving EPC income from China are generally subject to deemed profit method if no PE is established, but a WFOE operating under a fixed place of business shall compute actual net profit. Gain/loss on intercompany foreign exchange must be included.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 / Line 6 - Investment Income and Non-operating Items
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest, dividends, royalties, disposal of assets, and non-operating gains or losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-sourced dividend income from overseas subsidiaries may be taxable; participation exemption is available only for qualifying intercompany dividends from Chinese residents. Interest income paid by Chinese payers to the WFOE is subject to China-sourced rules, and the withholding tax credit mechanism must be reconciled on Schedule M.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after statutory adjustments and tax-exempt income deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure all permanent establishment income and China-sourced income are separately identified. Non-resident shareholders must receive the EIT withholding certificate (Form V) before dividend remittance. Adjustments for transfer pricing should be reflected here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 / Line 8 - Taxable Income at Preferential Rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income qualifying for reduced tax rates or exemptions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No preferential rate typically applies to a standard WFOE unless HNTE certification is secured. Transfer-pricing adjustments may invalidate preferential treatment for the adjusted portion. Any treaty-derived income should not be reported as preferential without a proper tax residence certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 / Line 9 - Tax Payable before Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computed at the applicable rate on taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the 25% statutory rate for a standard WFOE, or 15% if HNTE approved. Foreign tax credits, withholding credits, and preference reductions are not applied at this line but on subsequent lines.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 10 / Line 10 - Enterprise Income Tax Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credit, tax paid in other jurisdictions, and investment tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credit is limited to the Chinese EIT payable on the foreign-sourced income. A WFOE receiving intercompany dividends from abroad must attach Form M with a certified tax payment certificate from the foreign jurisdiction. Credits cannot exceed the Chinese tax attributable to that income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 11 / Line 11 - Total Tax Payable and Payments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final EIT liability after credits, prepayments, withholding, and prior installments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile quarterly provisional payments with annual tax payable. Any underpayment triggers daily interest at the benchmark lending rate. Overpayment may be refunded or carried forward upon written application.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 12 / Line 12 - Related Party Transactions Disclosure Schedule
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Controlled transaction matrix and transfer pricing adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete Schedule 'Related Party Transactions and Profitability' for any related-party transactions. Standard WFOE must include contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation; failure to do so shifts the tax burden and imposes a demerit penalty of up to 10% of the unreported transaction amount.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: RMB 2,000 maximum per occurrence (or RMB 50 per day for simple late filing); if the taxpayer has been warned, the penalty is RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000; for serious fraud, penalty up to RMB 10,000. Underpayment interest: daily 0.05% of underpaid tax. False tax return (tax evasion) triggers a fine of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax, plus criminal liability for directors under PRC Criminal Law if the amount is material.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on gross dividends paid to a non-resident corporate shareholder, unless reduced to 5% or 0% under an applicable Double Tax Treaty.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must: (1) submit a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the resident jurisdiction's tax authority for the calendar year of the dividend; (2) complete a Beneficial Ownership Declaration form under Announcement No. 9 of 2018; (3) demonstrate substantive business activity and no conduit/abusive arrangement; (4) file the DTA relief application with the Chinese withholding agent prior to payment; and (5) obtain the withholding agent's certification and, if requested, approval from the Chinese competent authority. In practice, the agent withholds at the treaty rate only after the TRC and beneficial ownership questionnaire are lodged and accepted.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT on interest and royalties paid to non-residents is 10% (with 5% business tax element simplified to combined 10% under current EIT and VAT rules). Under most Chinese DTAs, the treaty rate is 7%–10% for interest and 5%–10% for royalties, depending on the counterparty jurisdiction and whether the beneficial owner is a resident enterprise. Additionally, if the receiving enterprise is a Hong Kong comprehensive arrangement resident, the dividend WHT may be 5% when holding at least 25% of the WFOE's capital.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File preparation is mandatory when annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 200 million for tangible asset transfers, RMB 100 million for financial asset transfers or intangible asset transfers, or RMB 40 million in aggregate for other related-party transactions. Master File preparation is required if the consolidated related-party transaction volume exceeds RMB 1 billion. Country-by-Country reporting threshold is RMB 5.5 billion of group revenue.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not apply Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) in the same manner as the UAE or EU; however, the 'substance' of an enterprise is critical in countering treaty abuse and under the GAAR (Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 47, and Circ. No. 7, effective 2017). A WFOE conducting grain-silo construction must evidence core income-generating activities (CIGA) in China, including contract execution, project management, procurement, workforce, and risk assumption, to attribute profits to a permanent establishment. Pure 'letterbox' arrangements are disregarded, and profits may be reattributed on a deemed basis.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through Under-Reporting / Fake Invoices
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting or understating revenue from grain-silo construction milestones, using false VAT invoices to inflate costs, or concealing Chinese-source income in offshore shell accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under PRC Tax Administration Law Article 63, the taxpayer must pay underpaid tax, a fine of 50% to 500% of the underpaid amount, and late-interest at 0.05% daily. Criminal prosecution under Criminal Law Article 201 triggers a fine and/or imprisonment of up to 7 years for a materially large evasion amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and supervisors personally liable for the short-paid tax if the veil is pierced under PRC Company Law; they face asset attachment, travel bans (exit restrictions under Tax Collection Law Article 44), disqualification from management positions, and criminal imprisonment of 3–7 years plus confiscation of property for serious evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation Failure and Artificial Profit Shifting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare or provide contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation, or entering into intercompany transactions with a related offshore entity that has no economic substance, resulting in a distorted allocation of profit from construction activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under EIT Law Article 41 and Article 44, the tax authority may make a deemed adjustment and impose a penalty of up to 10% of the unreported cross-border related-party transaction value (Announcement 6 of 2017). In addition to the adjustment, late interest accrues at 0.05% daily (currently benchmark plus 5%).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve sham intercompany agreements face personal civil liability for the corporate tax shortfall when the corporate veil is pierced for fraud or abuse of limited liability; they may be subject to a 5-year entry ban and criminal prosecution for 'tax evasion' if the adjustment leads to a criminal threshold, carrying up to 7 years' imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance and AML Red Flags
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the WFOE as a pure shell or conduit for foreign investors without actual employees, offices, equipment, or business records, or accepting suspicious milestone-based transfers from a sanctioned jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law, the People's Bank of China may impose fines of RMB 2 million to RMB 10 million on the entity for non-compliance; tax authorities may re-attribute all profits to the non-resident parent and levy 10% WHT on deemed dividends under EIT Law Article 45 (CFC rules). Financial institution transaction freezing and business license revocation may also be ordered.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be blacklisted by customs and border-control (exit prohibition), their assets cannot be transferred, they face a fine of RMB 500,000 to RMB 1 million, and criminal liability for money laundering under Criminal Law Article 191 carries 5–10 years' imprisonment including confiscation of personal property. Civil tort liability follows for losses caused to creditors.
